scope: Post-hoc development-only numeric diagnosis. No model training, no new test text, no confirmatory inference. All oracle policies use hindsight labels and are nondeployable. Discovery logs predictions are in-sample; development predictions use the originally frozen discovery-fitted logs model.

temporal_scale_context.caution: This is only the direct AdamW first-moment recurrence factor, not a bound on final weight or loss differences. LR-half remains active for all updates; its one-step probe does not directly measure the sustained learning-rate policy.

interpretation_limits: Only seven independent development trajectories; 56 dependent conditions do not create 56 independent replications.
Marginal/centered correlations do not establish conditional information value beyond all free features.
Only horizons63/64 were collected; no data here can verify short-horizon diagnostic agreement or longer-term adaptation.
The physical three-forward selector is a post-hoc descriptive development comparator, not the frozen one-pair learner or a new confirmed method.
The current fixed ridge has more feature dimensions than discovery episodes; insufficient conditional fitting remains a possible contributor.
